resolveDigestRelayReport decodes relayCode with jwt.decode (no signature verification), so an attacker can forge an unsigned JWT carrying any teamId and retrieve that team's full SLA digest (ticket numbers, requester/assignee emails, org account numbers). The secure counterpart resolveSecureDigestRelayReport (line 269) verifies with jwt.verifyAsync + DIGEST_RELAY_SECRET, proving decode-without-verify is the defective authorization check.

organizationDesk grants cross-tenant desk access based solely on the attacker-controlled query param accountRelationship==='reseller_linked'; any authenticated user (incl. customer) can pass ?accountRelationship=reseller_linked with an arbitrary organizationId to list another org's tickets. The secure sibling resellerLinkedDesk (line 906) instead verifies a Contact row linking user.email to the org, proving the request-trusted flag is the flaw.
